causes: 1) Test blind spot: the spawned Machine rifleman in test_facexit8 / test_facreturn8 'machine near' is killed by the base guns within ~1 s (a head wound kills regardless of hp=1e9: Wound result dead at +24 ticks, shooter wt_mg). The gate stood down 20 s later, so the 'hardened' headless cases ran almost unhardened (that is why they were fast). The windowed flow keeps a threat near (hard=true to the end).

2) One-sided merge lock at the gate-lane head (fac_drive7 _drive): the APC on the lane axis (e.g. 1095 at local (13.4,17.6)) stopped for a stopped APC merging from the west garage row (1051 at (11.7,18.0)) via the 'APC in front never yields' look-ahead rule / D_SAFE circles, while 1051 itself was hull-blocked by 1095 (mutual-case resolution not reached: not mutual). Both stood ~55 s (+916..+2029) until a re-plan; every APC behind them queued. Can repeat in a game.

3) Throughput floor: the sally holds 2 APCs (geometry: inner band ends 22.88, outer wait 25.2, D_SAFE 1.95), so a hardened exit of 8 = 4 cycles of 4 door moves + 2 drive phases (~6 s each). With GATE_S 4.0 a cycle was ~575 ticks (29 s).

supply8_question: NOT covered. FacDrive7 only drives facility APC drivers (fac_drive7 vstate); a SUPPLY8 cargo carrier on plain Movement 'move' orders never requests the gate cycle (GT.wo/wi) and would stall at a hardened outer gate (Movement.set_gate nav-blocks it).
